sections.heading: Conditions without si: a review with nuance
sections.body:
- *siempre y cuando / siempre que* (provided that — strict condition): *Puedes usar el carro siempre y cuando lo cuides.*
- *a no ser que / salvo que / a menos que* (unless): *Saldremos a las seis, salvo que haya cambios.*
- *en caso de que* (in the event that): *En caso de que surja algún problema, llámeme.*
- *con tal de que* (as long as — often "just so"): *Hace cualquier cosa con tal de que lo dejen en paz.*
- *como* + subjunctive — a **warning or threat** (if…): *Como no me pagues mañana, te denuncio.* (If you don't pay me tomorrow, I'll report you.) Compare *como* + indicative = since: *Como no me pagaste, te denuncié.*

sections.heading: De + infinitive, simple and compound
sections.body:
*De* + infinitive replaces a *si* clause, in speech and writing:

- **Present / hypothetical**: *De tener dinero, viajaría más.* (= Si tuviera dinero…)
- **Past (compound infinitive)**: *De haberlo sabido, habría venido antes.* (= Si lo hubiera sabido…)
- **Negative**: *De no ser por ti, no lo habría logrado.* (If it weren't / hadn't been for you, I wouldn't have made it.)

Other reduced conditions: gerund (*Estudiando así, aprobarás.* — Studying like that, you'll pass), participle (*Bien hecho, el trabajo tomará un mes.*) and *con* + infinitive (*Con llamarlo basta.* — Just calling him is enough).

sections.heading: Mixed and implicit conditions
sections.body: Real speech often mixes times: *Si no hubieras gastado tanto, ahora tendrías dinero.* (past condition, present result) *Si fuera más paciente, no habría discutido con él.* (present condition, past result). Some conditions are implicit: *Yo que tú, no lo haría.* (If I were you, I wouldn't.) *En tu lugar, aceptaría.*

vocab: in your place / if I were you
examples: Puedes usar el carro siempre y cuando lo cuides.
You can use the car provided you look after it.
Saldremos a las seis, salvo que haya cambios.
We'll leave at six unless there are changes.
En caso de que surja algún problema, llámeme.
In the event that a problem arises, call me.
Hace cualquier cosa con tal de que lo dejen en paz.
He does anything just so they leave him alone.
Como no me pagues mañana, te denuncio.
If you don't pay me tomorrow, I'll report you.
Como no me pagaste, te denuncié.
Since you didn't pay me, I reported you.
De tener dinero, viajaría más.
If I had money, I'd travel more.
De haberlo sabido, habría venido antes.
Had I known, I would have come earlier.
De no ser por ti, no lo habría logrado.
If it hadn't been for you, I wouldn't have made it.
Estudiando así, aprobarás.
Studying like that, you'll pass.
Con llamarlo basta.
Just calling him is enough.
Si no hubieras gastado tanto, ahora tendrías dinero.
If you hadn't spent so much, you'd have money now.
Si fuera más paciente, no habría discutido con él.
If I were more patient, I wouldn't have argued with him.
Yo que tú, no lo haría.
If I were you, I wouldn't do it.
En tu lugar, aceptaría la oferta.
If I were you, I'd accept the offer.
Como sigas así, te vas a enfermar.
If you carry on like this, you're going to get sick.
